strategies.text: Disarms the tank, raises dead adds and hits hard (Thrash, Strike). Kill a couple of the necromancers first, then focus the boss.
Raises the dead, Shadow Bolt Volley on everyone and Curse of Thorns on the tank (it hurts whenever you deal damage); decurse it.
About 500 arcane damage on the tank and a channelled Focal Blast beam that sweeps one way for 3 s: step out of the beam.
Kill the two Mana Phantoms quickly and interrupt their Mana Burn. Dispel Manamorph; Silence AoE is avoidable for ranged.
Frontal cleave and a pulsing Malfunction AoE: face him away and keep ranged beyond 25 yards. A stun before the cast stops it.
Entangle roots with damage (Blessing of Freedom removes it); leave the green pools left by Fel Timbers at once.
Clear the whole room first. Drain Vitality on the tank, Debilitate hits everyone and drains 200 mana: kill it before mana runs out.

Similar to Shade of Aran: heavy Arcane Bolt on the tank, move the Shade off any Bounding Mana, stay outside the 20-yard Arcane Explosion. At 0 mana he casts Mass Polymorph and Evocation, then the fight resets.

notes: Forever-only dungeon in Alterac: no uiMapID, use instanceMapID 2959 and the floor names. Level range is the client table (28-35); Method says 28-35 and 26-33 in different places. Four bosses are estimates from the map labels (Krasus Landing, Runeweaver Square, the Violet Hold, the Violet Citadel); Atrexis, Lyn, the Arcanic Enigma and the Unstable Sentinel have no position. No NPC IDs (no open source). NeedRoll was used only as a cross-check. Needs the Dalaran Sewers Key (Alliance: two quests at Southshore Town Hall; Horde: Magus Wordeen Voidglare at Tarren Mill). Lyn the Ignored is secret: summoned with the Tome of Dalaran (crafted at the Ambermill ley line from a Black Tome found in Arugal's room in Shadowfang Keep). Quest NPCs inside the city: Grindle Firespark (removes the barriers before the Fel Ancient), Archmage Modera (opens the Shade's portal), Rexxie Copperclutch (Opportunistic Education); none has a position. Quest drop: Arcane Mote from the Shade.
